name: Helena Brandt
about_me: I'm Helena Brandt, a mechanical engineering professor at Michigan running a battery thermal-management lab. Two of my students want to spin out a startup. I'm looking for industry partners for an NSF grant and for investors who understand deep-tech timelines.
goals: Find an industry partner for the battery-cooling NSF grant

debriefs.text: Met Rachel Adler, an associate at Northwind Climate Fund, at our lab tour. She said Northwind backs grid and battery hardware and wants to meet our students early. She promised to send a founder FAQ.
Talked to Omar Haddad from GridLeaf. His storage units overheat in summer and he wants to test our cooling plates. He could be the industry partner on the grant.
Elena Ortiz at the Great Lakes Innovation Fund said their clean-tech pilot grants can match NSF funds. The deadline is January 10.
Derek Olsen, the patent attorney, advised us to file a provisional before the students present anywhere public.
Chen Wei from GM asked about our cooling results for their EV packs, but said GM partnerships take a year to sign.
